name: glassbox-trace
description: Glassbox for Claude Code: a session-review Stop hook plus skills to check, view and compare session transcripts.

plugins.name: glassbox
plugins.description: Ends every turn with a one-screen Glassbox summary (turns, tool calls, context peak, cost, top findings), optionally hands the findings back to the agent and keeps a memory the next session starts with, and adds /glassbox:check plus a skill for checking, searching, viewing and comparing sessions.
